notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001141391-26-000013). Payment network: formula applies with the sector flag. Net revenue is after rebates and incentives granted to customers (contra-revenue), so those payments to issuers and merchants are not in paidOut; operating cash flow carries them through prepaid expenses (−3,388) and amortization of customer incentives (2,098). No acquisitions of businesses in 2025. Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow; under the new income-tax disclosure the 10-K no longer prints a supplemental cash-flow line, so taxes come from the income-tax note's by-jurisdiction table and interest from the debt note (the filing tags that interest-paid sentence as us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt).
